🚨 Human metapneumovirus (HMPV)

A respiratory virus causing mild cold-like symptoms but can lead to severe illness in young children & the elderly. 

Here's the latest update on HMPV cases in China & India, and how to stay safe👇 https://t.co/jLlHru35LE

nodes.author: Unfiltered_mic
nodes.text:
CHINA UPDATE🇨🇳

- Late 2024: Surge in HMPV cases, esp. in northern regions & kids <14.

- Current Status: Infection rates decline as winter peaks.

Seasonal respiratory infections like these are common in colder months. https://t.co/5PD9qSkrxQ

nodes.author: Unfiltered_mic
nodes.text:
INDIA UPDATE🇮🇳

- First cases of HMPV reported (9 confirmed) in cities like Bengaluru, Ahmedabad, & Chennai.

- Affected: Mostly infants & young children.

Health Ministry: No alarm,cases align with typical winter respiratory illness trends. https://t.co/9RcgwTwdTK

nodes.author: Unfiltered_mic
nodes.text:
CAUTIONS

Adopt these simple preventive measures to protect yourself & your loved ones:

1. Hand Hygiene 🖐️

Wash hands often with soap for 20 sec.

No soap? Use alcohol-based sanitizer.

2. Respiratory Etiquette 🤧

Cover your mouth/nose with tissue or elbow when sneezing/coughing.

Dispose of tissues & wash hands after.

3. Avoid Close Contact ↔️

Stay away from those showing respiratory symptoms.

Don’t share utensils, towels, or bedding with sick individuals.

nodes.author: Unfiltered_mic
nodes.text:
4. Stay Home When Unwell 🏠

Cough, fever, or difficulty breathing? Rest & seek medical advice if needed.

5. Clean & Disinfect 🧽

Frequently clean doorknobs, light switches, mobile devices, etc.

6. Use Masks 😷

In crowded or poorly ventilated spaces, wearing a mask reduces virus spread.

Implementing these measures reduces the risk of HMPV & other respiratory infections.
